# s63 — sixth Deidara native cell: summon

Base `911612c8d4b3be605bc0377a31fd1e771563f738` (merged PR #85).
Branch `feat/sampling-summon-native-one-cell`. Exactly one new cell:
**`didala__summon__neutral__ground__near`**, 60 ticks, generated by the unchanged
sampling matrix. Evidence plus a bounded receipt-validator correction; no runtime/importer/probe changes.
`production_admitted=false`; `native_parity_proven=false`.

## Results

Real Flash: **4,858 events**, **122 actor observations** (both actors, ticks 0–60),
done at tick 60. Case-bound receipt sealed and revalidated. The recorded summon
intent uses native `o`/keycode 79 at ticks **10,11,12**; 954 source key reads
match intent, including one pressed summon read. No behavior/parity inference
is made from the number of reads.

Godot required-native execution accepts this cell's receipt: **1/324 executed,
no errors**, 122 states. Missing receipt, wrong-case receipt and missing native
sample reject; original receipt revalidates unchanged. Unmarked entries need no
receipt. Full campaign check exits 1 for other missing native receipts, as
expected; it is not weakened to certify a partial run. No attack/jump/dash/ranged/special rerun.

**47 focused tests**, integrity/handoff/contracts pass. Capture completeness is
not gameplay or pixel parity. There is no geometry/DL/camera/BitmapData/DoAction
capture in this slice.

## Root completion versus trace EOF

The first capture command completed, but the old adapter rejected its receipt:
`done` sequence 4854 at tick 60/display 542 is followed by four native random
records from `main#DefineSprite_256_XG_qdj/frame_1/DoAction.as`. The original
trace is retained byte-for-byte; no recapture or suffix trimming was used.
`terminal-boundary.json` records the exact suffix and initial rejection.

`bootstrap.as` emits done after both final actor states and then requests
`fscommand("quit")` inside the root observer. This is a root-observation boundary,
not proof that no same-display native callback remains. The adapter now requires
exactly one done at the requested final tick, after all expected actor states;
all later records must retain that same display counter and tick. The entire
suffix remains sequence-checked and receipt-hashed. Duplicate/early done,
later display/tick, missing samples and edited suffix bytes reject in tests.
No event kind is excluded or silently discarded; this does not certify complete
execution of every callback before process exit.

The original capture was sealed through `tools.sampling_native.seal` after this
validator correction, using the original case/build/trace and pinned player.
The retained capture-command log intentionally shows the initial exit-1 result;
`gate-proof.json` and the Godot report show the subsequent successful validation.

## Review map and reproduction

`gate-proof.json` records receipt/input checks and negative results;
`runtime-report.json` preserves the selected execution and incomplete campaign
status. Raw native trace/runtime traces are losslessly compressed. Build archive
contains only metadata, instrumentation diff and five bound SWFs. Matrix/case,
receipt, environment and artifact hashes preserve identities.

```sh
python3 -m tools.sampling_matrix generate --output /tmp/bvn-s63-campaign --fighters didala --require-native
python3 tools/probes/build_ai_reference.py --ffdec /tmp/bvn-loud-fail/r02/ffdec/ffdec.jar \
  --output /tmp/bvn-s63-build --run-id s63-didala-summon-20261027 --frames 60 \
  --move-case /tmp/bvn-s63-campaign/cases/didala__summon__neutral__ground__near.json \
  --p1-character 迪达拉 --p2-character 一护 --p1-helper 我爱罗 --p2-helper 魂
python3 -m tools.sampling_native \
  --case /tmp/bvn-s63-campaign/cases/didala__summon__neutral__ground__near.json \
  --build /tmp/bvn-s63-build --trace /tmp/bvn-s63-capture.log \
  --receipt /tmp/bvn-s63-receipts/didala__summon__neutral__ground__near.json --allow-window-activation
python3 -m tools.sampling_matrix run --campaign /tmp/bvn-s63-campaign \
  --output /tmp/bvn-s63-runtime --godot /tmp/bvn-loud-fail/r02/engine/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot \
  --cases didala__summon__neutral__ground__near --native-evidence /tmp/bvn-s63-receipts
python3 -m tools.sampling_matrix check --campaign /tmp/bvn-s63-campaign \
  --output /tmp/bvn-s63-runtime --native-evidence /tmp/bvn-s63-receipts
# Expected exit 1: other required native receipts are missing.
```

Fresh runs require fresh paths/run IDs. To revalidate the archived receipt,
restore build under `/private/tmp/bvn-s63-build`, decompress trace to its bound
path, restore original case at its path above, and use this commit's probes and
pinned player. Call `tools.sampling_native.validate(case_path, receipt_path)`.
Do not edit receipt hashes/paths. Player/JPEXS/source/probe/output hashes are
retained. Approved native-capture-only escalation covers ps/player launch/owned
cleanup; no permanent sandbox changes.

## Follow-ups / limits

The sixth cell lacks geometry, child-DL/full camera, BitmapData, DoAction and
internal ownership observations. Native/Godot behavioral parity, timer/random
alignment and static-loader attestation remain unproven. As in s28/s35,
`runtime_fighter=null` reflects the existing static-loader identity limitation;
configuration/source hashes bind the trusted build, not independent attestation.
Earlier-cell missing-return, source/mask and pixel/phase residuals remain
open. No new ports, full-roster native run, merge/deploy/Worker.
